metadata.description: Precomputed evaluation metrics for known test series. Generated by uniftsm. Do not edit manually.

linear_trend.description: Linear trend with slope 0.1, 200 points daily

seasonal.description: Seasonal series with period 12, 120 points daily

metric_definitions.MASE: Mean Absolute Scaled Error. Scale-adjusted accuracy metric, lower is better. Uses Naive seasonal=1 as baseline.
metric_definitions.sMAPE: Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error. Range [0, 200], lower is better.
metric_definitions.CRPS: Continuous Ranked Probability Score. Probabilistic calibration metric, lower is better.
metric_definitions.MAE: Mean Absolute Error. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.RMSE: Root Mean Squared Error. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.NMAE: Normalized Mean Absolute Error (divided by mean of y_true). Lower is better.
